name: anchises-stock-qa
description: Safe read-only Stocks_Tracker SQL exports for Codex CSV analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Read-only stock SQL exports to CSV.
interface.longDescription: Anchises Stock QA lets Codex inspect a user-configured read-only Stocks_Tracker MySQL database, validate SELECT-only SQL, export query results to CSV, and analyze those CSV files with pandas. Database URL, output cleanup, and prompt overrides are configured locally after installation.
defaultPrompt: Answer my stock question from configured Stocks_Tracker data.
Find the strongest momentum stocks from the latest data.
Which mining stocks had unusual volume recently?
